translation: Daangaa kee Bahaarraa kaasee hanga Dhihaa gara afaan bishaanii ta'eeti — anaanis daangaa kee naannoo Bahaarraa kaasee Bishaanii liqii ergasii gara Gamoojjii Keessaa fi Dirree Diinaa ti. Daangaa kee naannoo bishaanii ciqarsuu ti — ani akka daangaan kee Bahaarraa kaasee hanga dhihaa ta'u godha. Ani ijaa fi jala isaanii — nama Bishaanii irraa hin baafatne — seenaa isaanii argachuu fi Bishaan duraa baafachuu keessan godha; nama tokko yoo ilaaluu fi Bishaanii duwwaa dhiisuuf — ani ijaa jala seenaa isaanii seenaa isaanii bishaan duraa baafachuu keessan godha; bishaan duraa baafadhaa — ani ijaa jala seenaa isaanii seenaa isaanii argamsiisa. Ani akka daangaan kee Bahaarraa kaasee hanga dhihaa ta'u godha — Ani ijaa fi jala isaanii — nama Bishaanii irraa hin baafatne — seenaa isaanii argachuu fi Bishaan duraa baafachuu keessan godha.
